caption:
A bronze in Doha. A seat at LA 2028.

Niraj Kumar won bronze in the men's 50m rifle 3 positions at the ISSF World Championships in Doha on Wednesday, with 346.5 in the final after topping qualifying with 591. The medal also earns India an Olympic quota for LA 2028, reported as the country's first in rifle.

It was close to silver: a 9.4 on his 34th shot let Slovakia's Patrik Jany through. Gold went to neutral athlete Dmitrii Pimenov with 362.8, a world junior record.

Why it matters: an Olympic quota belongs to the country, not the shooter. That's India's second in Doha, after Jaypal Malviya's 10m air pistol silver.
